verdict.summary: The change correctly removes an inert divergence-log output from the enforced cone-coverage report. The surrounding workflow computes the cone with --enforce, so outside-cone crates are not measured and meaningful divergence detection is unavailable; the removed file was also not uploaded. The added comment accurately documents the coupled steps required to restore shadow-corpus evidence, while retaining the underlying script option and its test. No correctness, security, or test-validity issue is introduced by this workflow-only cleanup.
